description: Get the pickup pass again for a paid order, when the user asks for their QR, pickup code or pass link (lost the email, closed the card). Returns the pass link, the six-character pickup code and the QR, shown as the pass card. Needs the claim create_pickup_order returned. An unpaid order has no pass yet: to see where an order is up to, use order_status instead.

claim.description: The claim create_pickup_order returned with the order. With it, a paid order's pass comes back too.

order_id.description: The order id create_pickup_order returned, like "ord_7HkQ2mXc9aRt".

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: get_pickup_pass
title: Get the pickup pass
